verdict.rationale: Kong's decK CLI supports declarative config export/diff/sync enabling versioning of gateway configs in git and rollback via re-apply of prior state, and Insomnia supports exporting design docs for version control. However there is no dedicated 'automation' review/rollback workflow or built-in versioning UI/history for AI-native automations specifically—evidence only covers API/gateway config management, not a general automation-review-rollback feature.
